name: meeting-invite-scanner
description: Browser extension: Extract Zoom meeting ID + passcode from invite screenshots or pasted text on-device, cache for up to 8h, and join via desktop app or web with a preset name. 100% offline & private. Unofficial, not affiliated with Zoom.

scripts.zip: rm -f dist/meeting-invite-scanner.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r -FS dist/meeting-invite-scanner.zip manifest.json popup.html popup.css popup.js privacy.html src vendor icons
